expected_root_cause: The completion parser treats a request after the -- separator as no longer being a shell completion. That allows the normal command action to run even though the shell is only asking for completion and no flags are valid after --.
fix_summary: Track completion-after-double-dash as a per-run state, keep the request in completion mode, return no suggestions, and prevent command action execution.
curation_notes: Issue #1993 is named in the regression tests; PR #2412 covers root and subcommand completion, state reset between runs, and the no-action invariant.
